chars.Y: YASSINE: a young man wearing a navy blue blazer over a white shirt, beige chinos, brown loafers and a gold wristwatch.
chars.W: SALMA (his wife): a young woman wearing an emerald green satin blouse, white wide-leg trousers, gold hoop earrings and a small gold handbag.
chars.K: KARIM (his best friend): a young man wearing a mustard-yellow bomber jacket over a black t-shirt, black jeans, white sneakers and dark sunglasses pushed up on his forehead.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Elegant villa living room in Rabat. In the center, SALMA and KARIM sit close together on a sofa laughing loudly at a joke, leaning toward each other. Behind them YASSINE stands holding a tray of mint tea, looking at them with a confused, slightly awkward expression. Comic awkward mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Sunny tennis club in Rabat with palm trees. KARIM and SALMA play doubles together on the same side of the net, high-fiving happily; YASSINE on the other side swings his racket and misses the ball. Playful comic mood.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Upscale café terrace in Rabat at sunset. YASSINE leans back relaxed in a chair with a coffee, eyes closed, big peaceful smile, enjoying life.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Villa entrance hall in the evening. SALMA walks out the front door quickly, waving goodbye over her shoulder with her gold handbag, dressed to go out; YASSINE sits alone on a sofa in the background, holding the TV remote, mouth slightly open, surprised.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Home office. YASSINE sits at his desk raising both hands in a calm shrug, eyebrows raised, as if saying it's not my business, a laptop open in front of him.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Living room. YASSINE stands confidently with one hand on his chest and the other raised like giving a speech, proud and open-minded expression, a bookshelf behind him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Street in front of the villa. KARIM opens the passenger door of a sports car for SALMA, both smiling at each other; YASSINE on the villa balcony above waves at them happily and innocently.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Café terrace by the sea in Rabat. SALMA and KARIM sit at a small table laughing hard together, KARIM touching her arm; in the far background, YASSINE gives a big cheerful thumbs up, totally clueless.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Dark bedroom at night. YASSINE lies in bed, his face lit by the glow of his phone screen (screen facing away from the viewer), eyes wide open in shock, sitting up suddenly. Tense mood.
